description:
On develop 34de720b8, `scripts/check_comment_policy.py --mode strict` reports 188 findings. None is in first-party code: 114 are in _sources/tpc-ds, 54 are binary coverage-errors in benchbox/_binaries, 19 are in _sources/tpc-h, and 1 is a vendored wheel. With `--ownership-base` the count drops to 1: quality/comment-policy.json:76 still names `_project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.8.1-py3-none-any.whl`, but the wheel was bumped in #2633.

`make comment-policy-strict` (Makefile:449-451) passes no ownership base, so the ownership manifest is not applied. The docs already call strict a diagnostic (docs/development/comment-policy.md:16-18 and :58), but docs/development/comment-policy.md around lines 66-68 still says the PR that flips the mode to blocking should be checked with `make comment-policy-strict`. That flip can no longer happen.

Absorbs comment-policy-strict-mode-reconciliation: no first-party findings remain, so there is nothing left to triage into batches. This also meets the unmet "strict passes on develop" criterion of the done item comment-cleanup-final-enforcement.
